query: This dashboard route renders a title and account summary that are already known, plus a report table whose query takes a few seconds. Keep the title and summary visible while the report is pending or fails. Add empty and forbidden results too. A teammate asks to keep it simple with one route-level loading.tsx and error.tsx.
baseline_failure: Agent accepts the route-level error boundary despite the stated survival requirement, so a report failure replaces the useful title and account summary.
expected_behavior: Streams the slow region behind its own boundary while the already-known content renders immediately
Renders empty results and denied permission as component states, not thrown failures
Scopes the error surface to the segment and offers retry rather than replacing the document
Gives the placeholder the shape of the resolved content so the layout does not shift
anti_expectation: Does NOT wrap the whole page in one pending boundary
Does NOT report the failure again inside the error boundary
Does NOT swallow framework navigation such as notFound in a generic catch
evaluation_note: A 2026-07-29 gpt-5.6-luna baseline kept stable content in a parent layout, so the predicted ownership failure did not reproduce. The guidance remains a documentation-backed hypothesis.
